Every vertical cap has fraction one half since (X,z)↦(−X,z) preserves K and interchanges the two sides of every vertical plane through the origin. In the normal equation the last coordinate tests only the two horizontal-section orientations, forcing equal total weights. The other coordinates give independent balance within the vertical-section subspace.
